target_customer: Mobile users planning social activities with friends
problem: Planning fun events with friends did not fit in ordinary work oriented calendars; Assorted Bits built a mobile calendar for social plans.
business_model: Unknown, consumer app with no stated revenue model

founders.name: Aston Motes
founders.background_notes: Now interim executive director at /dev/color (YC W16) per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile calendar with sharing is standard app engineering, with calendar sync as the main hard part.

defensibility.rationale: No network effect or data moat was evident and calendar vendors could copy features quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platform calendars and Facebook Events already served the wedge; later social calendar entrants such as Sunrise, Cal and UpTo appeared in 2013 and 2014.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand near the S12 batch was found.

branding.domain_note: Product site youthere.com (404 as of 2026-11); company name differs from product name

brand_strength.rationale: No brand evidence found; company and product names differ, and the site is dead.

outcome_analysis: Assorted Bits was a Summer 2012 YC company building a social mobile calendar, and YC lists it as Inactive. The cause of shutdown is not public in anything found: no post-mortem, funding record or press was located. The social calendar category stayed crowded, but no source ties that to this closure, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: Website youthere.com returned 404, treated as dead. Shutdown cause not public. Competitor sources found date from 2013 and later, after founding, so list is empty. Name and branding details unknown.
